To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the spatial response of a source-collimator-detection system for a given source-collimator geometry is independent of the size and position of the detector; (2) the spatial response is independent of the source activity; (3) the spatial response depends on the number and size of the collimator apertures; and (4) the spatial response varies linearly with the collimator thickness.

the spatial response of a source-collimator—detector system is dependent on the geometry of the source, the geometry of the collimator, the position and orientation of the detector with respect to the source and collimator, and the position and orientation in space of the source and collimators with respect to the detector.
the 3-D system spatial response can be accurately modeled using a computer code that is based on a simple mathematical formulation of the problem.
